original_hook: 🚨 Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub 📰 CoinDesk reports that stablecoin wallets are beginning to challenge traditional bank accounts as primary consumer money hubs. This isn't just a payments story—it changes underlying market liquidity. As payment-ready digital dollars settle natively on-chain, capital remains inside the crypto ecosystem rather than off-ramping back into legacy banks. With $BTC compressing near $79,234, an expanding stablecoin reserve alters how market drawdowns function. Instead of net capital flight, funds rotate locally between yield-bearing stablecoins and spot assets. Bullish, bearish, or wait Is this a real repricing event or temporary headline noise?
